RedisConnectionException: UnableToConnect on redis-cart:6379 ... clientName: cartservice-79b49f5555-z2z4g' -> failing edge cartservice -> redis-cart:6379. Object layer: pods listing outlier row only 'redis-cart-56db4dcdd5-n9flp 0/1 ContainerCreating 0 113s IP=<none> NODE=worker-01' while all 10 peer pods are 1/1 Running; endpoints/redis-cart shows '<none>' while services/redis-cart declares 6379/TCP; redis-cart-pvc is 'Bound' to redis-cart-pv (storage face healthy, rules out PVC/mount class). Node face (general then specific): GetClusterConfiguration shows worker-01 status 'Unknown' with conditions MemoryPressure/DiskPressure/PIDPressure all 'Unknown' and taints node.kubernetes.io/unreachable:NoSchedule,NoExecute, while master/worker-02/worker-03 are Ready; namespace events show 5x 'Warning NodeNotReady' for the worker-01 pods (adservice, shippingservice, checkoutservice, emailservice, paymentservice). Mechanism event: CheckNodeServiceStatus(worker-01, kubelet) returns 'Active: inactive (dead) since Fri 2025-12-05 16:21:01 CST' with journal tail 'Stopping Kubernetes Kubelet... ExecStart=.../kubelet (code=exited, status=0/SUCCESS) ... Stopped Kubernetes Kubelet.'. Control: on the same node containerd is 'active (running) 2h 11min' and logs 'RunPodSandbox ... returns sandbox id' + 'StartContainer ... returns successfully', and kube-proxy is 'active (running)' - so the runtime and proxy are not the breakpoint. Config confirmation: GetAppYAML(redis-cart) pins the only replica via nodeSelector 'kubernetes.io/hostname: worker-01', so when that node's kubelet died the container was started by containerd but never reported ready - Pod stays ContainerCreating/Pending with no IP, the Service gets no endpoints, and every cartservice Redis call times out (5000ms backlog), surfacing as checkout/cart unavailability at frontend. Breakpoint: worker-01 kubelet unavailable; victim business unit app/redis-cart, mechanism owner node/worker-01.

Scope the quota branch to the Service named by the complaint or the target of the failing call; missing Services that are not that victim are background. **No ResourceQuota object at all means the quota branch is excluded** — return to the symptom side and take the branch the healthy objects land on. kind: PersistentVolume

  hostPath:

    type: DirectoryOrCreate

apiVersion: v1
kind: PersistentVolumeClaim
metadata:
  name: redis-cart-pvc
  namespace: boutique
spec:
  accessModes:
    - ReadWriteOnce
  resources:
    requests:
      storage: 2Gi
  storageClassName: ""
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: redis-cart
  namespace: boutique
  labels:
    app: redis-cart
spec:
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: redis-cart
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: redis-cart
    spec:
      nodeSelector:
        kubernetes.io/hostname: worker-01
      securityContext:
        fsGroup: 1000
        runAsGroup: 1000
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 1000
      containers:
      - name: redis
        securityContext:
          allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
          capabilities:
            drop:
              - ALL
          privileged: false
          readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
        image: redis:alpine
        ports:
        - containerPort: 6379
        readinessProbe:
          initialDelaySeconds: 5
          tcpSocket:
            port: 6379
        livenessProbe:
          initialDelaySeconds: 5
          tcpSocket:
            port: 6379
        volumeMounts:
        - mountPath: /data
          name: redis-data
        resources:
          limits:
            memory: 256Mi
            cpu: 200m
          requests:
            cpu: 100m
            memory: 128Mi
      volumes:
      - name: redis-data
        persistentVolumeClaim:
          claimName: redis-cart-pvc
---

kind: Service
metadata:
  name: redis-cart
  namespace: boutique
  labels:
    app: redis-cart
spec:
  type: ClusterIP
  selector:
    app: redis-cart
  ports:
  - name: tcp-redis
    port: 6379
    targetPort: 6379
